requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "New Hire Onboarding Guide"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Welcome to MoaLogis."}, {"id": 2, "text": "This document walks you through what to do step by step during your first two weeks ▶"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "For questions, please contact Joonho Byun (Joonho Byun), HR manager."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Seojin Um (Seojin Um) will help you with setting up your development environment."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Day one"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "When you arrive, first collect your access badge from the front desk on the first floor."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The access badge you receive will be registered by Manager Byeon Jun-ho."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Your seat is next to the Dawn Team, and Eom Seo-jin will sit in the same row."}, {"id": 2, "text": "You will have lunch with your teammates."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Day two"}, {"id": 1, "text": "On day two you spend the whole day on site."}, {"id": 2, "text": "For unloading work, observe while wearing safety shoes."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Do not speak first to drivers who are on a job."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The field trip report goes up to the team lead for approval."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Once you've reviewed it, it gets forwarded to Manager Byeon Jun-ho."}, {"id": 2, "text": "First week"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "New MoaLogis hires work through a checklist called 'Launchpad' during their first week."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Launchpad item 1 is logging into the wiki and signing up for the internal messenger."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Company-wide announcements and casual chat happen in the 'Hearth' channel."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Onboarding step 2 is taking the Pathfinder training on the fleet allocation system."}, {"id": 1, "text": "You will build a full day's fleet allocation plan yourself using Pathfinder."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Do not post practice screens to Hearth."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "You don't need to write long reports."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Once you finish the scaffolding, you'll start on real work in the second week."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Your first real task is to get a code review with Eom Seo-jin."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "We share code review results in the team channel for 모닥불."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to Manager Byeon Junho at any time."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Finally, just leave a one-line impression on Modakbul and you're done."}]}
